how_to_apply: Visit http://www.kashmiruniversity.ac.in and click the Jobs/Recruitment link. Read the detailed instructions and the preview of the registration and application process.
Register through the "Register as an Applicant" link, using a valid Email id and mobile number. Remember the Username and Password.
Log in with the Username and Password.

Enter personal details, educational qualifications and experience, then preview the form. If details are correct, click Submit. To correct anything, go back through Preview, make corrections and then Submit. No editing or updating is allowed after submission.
Get a printout of the form and note the Form No.
Select payment and deposit the Application Fee of Rs. 1050/- in online mode (online banking/Credit/Debit card).

Submit the printout of the online application with enclosures, numbered at the right-hand top margin as per the auto-generated serial numbers, the online payment acknowledgement, properly bound. Hand it in personally or send it by Speed Post/Registered Post to Deputy Registrar (Recruitment), Administrative Block, University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar-190006, J&K.

Superscribe the envelope: "Application for the post of ………………………, Post ID ………… Advertisement notice No. ………. Dated …………." The hard copy must reach by or before 23 December 2026, and a postal application received after the last date is rejected summarily without any notice.
important_instructions: Applicants should write their name strictly as per Matriculation/Higher Secondary Certificates. Applicants wishing to apply in more than one category must apply separately for each category, subject to fulfilling the eligibility conditions. Incomplete application forms, forms without enclosures, and applications received late or incomplete in any respect are not entertained. No TA/DA is paid to candidates for appearing in the interview. The University reserves the right not to fill any of the advertised vacancies if circumstances so warrant, without assigning any reason. Canvassing in any form by or on behalf of the candidate is a disqualification. Impersonation or submission of false, fabricated or tampered documents bars the candidate permanently or for a specific period and may lead to criminal prosecution. The University verifies the character, antecedents and documents at any time of appointment or during service. Fake documents or suppressed information lead to termination. During probation, the selected candidate must make consistent efforts to publish quality papers in UGC-CARE journals with ISSN and take one research project in the area of specialization. Appointment terms are governed by the Kashmir & Jammu Universities Act, 1969, its Statutes and Regulations, and UGC and Union Ministry of Education provisions where applicable. Where the University has no service rules of its own, those prescribed by the Government of the UT apply. Any addendum or corrigendum will be uploaded on the University website only, with no separate intimation. The notice is subject to the outcome of any pending writ petition.

content_sections.text: The reservation break-up for each subject is given below, with dashes as printed. The notice's category columns are OM, SC, ST1, ST2, BA, OBC, EWS and LAC/IB. content_sections.heading: University of Kashmir Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/Industry. A minimum of seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC listed journals and a total research score of 75 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of UGC Guidelines, July 2018. Published research work of good quality on any aspect of Iqbal studies. Published research work of good quality on any aspect of Kashmiri Culture, History, Religion or Philosophy, preferably relevant to Reshi Movement/ Spiritual tradition/identity of Kashmir. Only publications in journals indexed in UGC-CARE Listed Journals, Scopus or Web of Science are considered for all academic purposes, with effect from 14.6.2019. Publications in predatory/dubious journals or conferences are not considered for academic credit. Each API score must be supported by documentary evidence in the Performance Based Appraisal System (PBAS) Proforma, and Page Nos. must be marked on all supporting documents. Details of ISSN/ISBN, sole author/co-authors/joint publication, refereed/non-refereed, indexed/non-indexed and local/national/international status must be reflected in the publication part of the PBAS proforma. Candidates must fulfil the eligibility criteria on or before the last date of receipt of applications. A relaxation of 5% (from 55% to 50% marks) may be provided to Ph.D. Degree holders who obtained their Master's Degree before 19 September 1991. Where the grading system is followed, grade "B" is regarded as equivalent to 55%. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Candidates with a post graduate/Ph.D. degree from a foreign university must enclose an "Equivalence Certificate" issued by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi. Without it, the candidature is not considered and the application is rejected. Applications by Government servants must be sent through the Administrative Authority concerned. For University teachers/employees, they go through the Registrar of their University. For persons employed in private firms and institutions, they go through the Head of the firm/institution. Applications not routed through the respective channels are liable to be rejected, but such candidates may send an advance copy at the earliest, followed by the application through proper channel.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply online for University of Kashmir Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online forms is 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. When do applications start?

faq.question: Q4. Which departments have Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: The posts are in various departments, institutes and centres of the Main Campus, such as Arabic, Botany, Computer Science, Law, Management Studies and Zoology. The full list is in this article.

faq.question: Q5. How many Associate Professor posts are there in University of Kashmir Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 74 Associate Professor posts across 39 departments, institutes and centres. The notice calls the number of vacancies tentative and says the University may increase or decrease it at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a good academic record with a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline and a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks. Iqbal Institute and Shaikh-Ul-Aalam Centre have their own subject conditions.

faq.question: Q8. How much experience and research output is required?
faq.answer: A minimum of eight years of teaching and/or research in a position equivalent to Assistant Professor, with at least seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC listed journals and a total research score of 75.
